sv.title: Megaspeed: Alice Huang inte anställd hos oss
sv.summary: Före detta Nvidia-vd:n Jensen Huangs påstådda älskarinna Alice Huang, som pekats ut som kinesisk spion, har ingen roll kvar i molnbolaget Megaspeed, enligt ett uttalande från bolaget, rapporterar Reuters.

en.title: Megaspeed: Alice Huang not employed by us
en.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's alleged mistress Alice Huang, who has been named as a Chinese spy, no longer has a role at cloud company Megaspeed, according to a statement from the company, Reuters reports.
